title: Networks
description: Manage your isolated VPN networks and Hub-and-Spoke configurations.
searchPlaceholder: Search networks by name, CIDR, or interface...
deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete network "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone and will disconnect all devices.

card.open: Open details: devices, rules, groups, topology

newCard.title: Create New Network
newCard.description: Set up a completely isolated VPN environment with its own subnet.

form.title: Create New Network
form.name: Network Name
form.cidrHint: Leave it empty: the server takes the next free /24 of the address pool {{pool}}. A CIDR you type must lie inside the pool.
form.interfaceNote: A dedicated WireGuard interface and listening port will be automatically assigned to this network.

detail.clientDnsDefault: Default: 1.1.1.1 for full tunnel, none for split
detail.clientDnsHint: Up to 3 IPv4 addresses, comma separated. Devices ask the hub; the hub forwards to these at once — no device needs a new config.
detail.ownerHint: A user whose role shows only their own networks sees this network when they own it.

admin.name: Admin VPN
admin.note: Your management device connects here; the panel opens only from this network.

tunnel.label: Tunnel
tunnel.splitDesc: Only traffic to the VPN networks goes through the server; the internet goes over the device’s own connection.
tunnel.fullDesc: All of the device’s internet traffic goes through the server; websites see the server’s IP address.
tunnel.choose: What should the devices of this network send through the server?
tunnel.affected_one: {{count}} device switches and needs its config downloaded again.
tunnel.affected_other: {{count}} devices switch and need their configs downloaded again.
tunnel.affectedNone: No device switches: devices with their own mode keep it.
tunnel.fullWarn: Full tunnel sends all internet traffic of these devices through the server: its traffic and load grow.
tunnel.engineNft: nftables engine: the change applies at once and is rolled back unless you confirm it within 60 seconds.
tunnel.engineIptables: iptables engine: only the device configs change.
tunnel.blockRole: Only an admin can choose full tunnel.
tunnel.blockEngine: Full tunnel on the Admin VPN needs the nftables firewall engine.
tunnel.donePending: The firewall change is waiting for confirmation: press “Confirm” in the bar above.
tunnel.redownload: Download the config again on the affected devices (device page → Config / QR).
tunnel.formHint: You can change this later; devices then need their configs downloaded again.
tunnel.confirmed: Confirmed: the tunnel mode has changed.
tunnel.rolledBack: Not confirmed in time: the firewall went back to its previous state and the tunnel mode did not change.

status.downHint: The WireGuard interface of this network does not run on the server: devices cannot connect. The server retries every 30 seconds.

dnsStatus.label: DNS through the hub
dnsStatus.direct: Not answering — configs name the DNS servers
dnsStatus.directHint: Device configs name the DNS servers directly until the hub can answer at {{hub}}. The server tries again every 30 s.

kpi.attentionHint: {{outdated}} config outdated · {{soon}} expire in 7 days · {{expired}} expired

page.trafficNote: From the WireGuard counters of each device; the device page has the history.
page.policiesHint: Whether this network can reach each other network, and the other way round.
page.rulesHint: Every rule with an end in this network: the network itself, one of its devices, a group with members here, or anyone.
page.noGroups: No group has devices in this network.
page.noLimits: No limit profile covers devices of this network.
page.topologyHint: This network with its devices; arrows show where traffic may go to or come from other networks (green: allowed, amber: partly). Click a device or network to open it.

ownLimitNote: Your role shows only the networks you create.
ownLimitFull: You have reached your role’s limit: delete a network to create another.
